title: MathCore: Sandbox Survivor
description: 2D neon survival sandbox where you pilot a mathematical core craft. Match dynamic equations using 4 face buttons, build algebraic parity turrets, and unleash lightning strikes.
controls: Left Stick / WASD: Move Core Craft
✕, ◯, ▢, △ (A, B, X, Y): 4 Core Math Operations
RT / Space: Kinetic Bolt & EMP Shockwave
LT / F / Right Click: Place Geometric Defense Tower
LB / RB / Q, E: Cycle Building Blueprint
